text:
emma: quick UX / a11y note from testing the batch embeddings export. two small but recurring annoyances: 1) VoiceOver reads a 20-row CSV sample out loud when the modal opens, super noisy. 2) the primary button label reads "Export" which feels vague when users have several exports.

ryan: i saw that. the sample table is rendered into the DOM and focus sometimes lands in it. keyboard users get stuck tabbing through cells.

anita: proposed fixes:
- set initial focus to the dialog heading (tabindex=-1 and focus()) so AT reads title first
- keep the sample table aria-hidden until user explicitly expands "Show sample"
- use an aria-live polite region for a short summary on open: e.g. "Preview collapsed: 20 rows, ~120KB"
- make primary CTA explicit: "Start export (20 items)" or add aria-label: "Start export of 20 vectors"

lucia: copy + microcopy tweaks:
- heading: "Export 20 vectors"
- summary line: "CSV (id, text, score). Runs in background; we will notify you."
- sample toggle: "Show CSV sample (3 rows, ~2KB)"
- filename default: "vectors-collectionname-20260323-20rows.csv" to avoid overwrites

dev-bot: staging: export-sr-tidy deployed to staging at commit 3f5a9b. smoke tests queued.

emma: action items recap:
- focus heading on open (dev)
- sample table aria-hidden until toggle; add aria-expanded state on toggle (dev + a11y)
- add polite aria-live summary on open (a11y)
- change CTA copy to "Start export" + aria-label with count (design)
- default filename pattern to include collection and date (product/eng)
- ensure exported CSV header order matches preview header (dev)

ryan: +1, i'll take focus + aria-hidden work.
anita: +1, i'll add test steps for NVDA/VoiceOver.
lucia: +1, i'll update Figma copy and the sample toggle label.
